executionOwner: R9 fixed direct-process runner; parent grants each actual Java/native execution
scope: First fixed factory: finite real Orders servlet context cases only. Inventory requires its own future executed scope; no Gateway/APIM or full-path/global acceptance.

javaFixturePort.registration: Test-fixture-only highest-precedence servlet filter registered before Spring startup; never a production endpoint/auth exemption
javaFixturePort.requestCaseFormat: Actual runner-generated nonzero UUIDv4; input/control identity, never an observed trace/span identity
javaFixturePort.originalRuntimePrivacy: Reject unexpected keys, wrong types, private shared-policy strings/fields, exact forbidden markers including the actual publisher in the RUNTIME-ONLY marker scope, and non-file or query/hash/auth-bearing CodeSource URIs before retaining any original runtime frame. Native R8 session markers deliberately exclude its legitimate top-level publisher. Strict UTF8/decoded-duplicate JSON parsing precedes object creation; UTC is canonical ISO-Z/valid calendar with actual JavaInstant zero-to-nine fractions; no comments, offsets, removal, masking or backfill.

requiredOutput.tracestateFields: Original getHeaders(tracestate) values, bounded eight fields/512UTF8 bytes each
